ai.sum: Ursula von der Leyen will visit the Black Sea after at least seven commercial vessels were hit by drones many link to Russia.

items.title: US$330,000 bail posted for senior Ukrainian police official in Carthage case
items.summary: Bail of UAH 15 million (about US$330,000) has been posted for Volodymyr Tsenov, First Deputy Head of the National Police's Strategic Investigations Department, who is implicated in the Carthage case and was remanded in custody by the High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) yesterday.

ai.sum: Volodymyr Tsenov, a senior Ukrainian police official implicated in the Carthage case, was released on UAH 15 million bail after a court remand.

items.title: Preparation for leaders' meeting, sectoral ceasefire: Ukraine outlines agenda for Abu Dhabi talks
items.summary: The Office of the President of Ukraine has outlined the issues that may be discussed during trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.

ai.sum: Ukraine's Presidential Office outlined agenda items, including a leaders' meeting and a sectoral ceasefire, for trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Putin receives message from Khamenei at talks with senior Iranian official — Kremlin
items.summary: The same information was reported by official Iranian media outlets following the meeting

ai.sum: The Kremlin said Putin received a message from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei during talks with a senior Iranian official.

items.title: Russia attacks several DTEK energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk region Friday morning
items.summary: On the morning of November 6, several DTEK energy facilities in the Dnipropetrovsk region came under strike simultaneously, the energy holding company reported on Friday.

ai.sum: Russia struck several DTEK energy facilities in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region on the morning of November 6.

items.title: Russia receives no European proposals on security guarantees, Kremlin says
items.summary: Earlier, closed-door talks involving representatives of the United States, NATO, European countries and Ukraine were held in Brussels

ai.sum: The Kremlin said Russia has received no European proposals on security guarantees following closed-door talks in Brussels.

items.title: Russia to show global community evidence of Ukraine destroying cultural sites
items.summary: The collected materials will serve as a basis for the future restoration and preservation of monuments

ai.sum: Russia plans to present evidence to the international community of Ukraine destroying cultural sites.

items.title: Putin discusses partnership, regional situation with Iranian Security Council secretary
items.summary: The Russian side also confirmed that Mohsen Rezaei had delivered a message from Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to Putin

ai.sum: Putin discussed partnership and the regional situation with Iran's Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei, who delivered a message from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

items.title: Death toll from Russian strike on Komyshuvakha rises to 53 as search operation enters 5th day
items.summary: The strike was the deadliest Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia Oblast since the start of the full-scale invasion.

ai.sum: Russian strike on Komyshuvakha in Zaporizhzhia Oblast killed 53, the deadliest Russian attack on that oblast since the full invasion began.

items.title: Russians again strike energy facilities that took three days to repair
items.summary: Russian forces attacked several energy facilities belonging to DTEK, the largest private energy company in Ukraine, in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast again on the morning of 6 November, damaging equipment and causing a fire.

ai.sum: Russian forces again struck DTEK energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, damaging equipment and causing a fire.

items.title: Torture chambers in Ukraine have been known about since 2014, lawmaker says
items.summary: According to Alexander Dubinsky, the case of the secret prison in Petropavlovskaya Borshchagovka near Kiev, which was uncovered in early November, is noteworthy because the authorities had to acknowledge its existence at the national level without delay

ai.sum: Russian lawmaker Alexander Dubinsky says Ukrainian torture chambers have been known since 2014, referring to a secret prison near Kyiv.

items.title: Russian forces strike several energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk region
items.summary: Russian forces struck several energy facilities in the Dnipropetrovsk region on the morning of November 6. The facilities had previously been targeted in Russian attacks.

ai.sum: Russian forces struck several energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk region on 6 November, including sites hit previously.

items.title: SBU conducts investigative actions in ‘Monaco case’; lawyer Nayyem reports search of GUR officer’s premises
items.summary: On the morning of Friday, November 6, lawyer Masi Nayyem reported that a search was being conducted at the residence of an officer from the Main Intelligence Agency (GUR) of the Ministry of Defence of Ukraine.

ai.sum: Ukraine's SBU conducted searches in the 'Monaco case', including at the home of a GUR officer.

items.title: Franco-Ukrainian Alta Ares wins 6 of 16 NATO counter-drone system lots
items.summary: Franco-Ukrainian defense company Alta Ares has won six out of 16 lots within the framework of a NATO contract for the supply of counter-unmanned aerial system (C-UAS) equipment, representing the highest number among all participants.

ai.sum: Franco-Ukrainian firm Alta Ares won six of 16 lots in a NATO contract for counter-drone systems, the most of any participant.

items.title: SBU and arms manufacturers to bolster info protection against hostile intelligence services under Forpost program
items.summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) and representatives from over 300 Ukrainian arms manufacturing companies have agreed to strengthen cooperation to counter hostile intelligence services.

ai.sum: Ukraine's SBU agrees with over 300 arms manufacturers to strengthen cooperation against hostile intelligence services.

items.title: Secret prisons row may harm Zelensky, but not current regime, expert says
items.summary: According to Alexander Dudchak, it is important for the West to maintain the same regime in Ukraine

ai.sum: Russian expert Alexander Dudchak comments that the secret prisons row may harm Zelensky but not the current Ukrainian regime.

items.title: Production of Svarog 20 V2 cargo drone is almost 100% localized — developer
items.summary: Russian specialists have developed a version of the craft that consists entirely of Russian-made components, including the frame, motor, flight controller, anti-jamming antenna and batteries

ai.sum: A Russian developer says its Svarog 20 V2 cargo drone is almost fully localised, with Russian-made key components.

items.title: Russia moves to let airlines keep flying foreign-leased planes they never returned after the full-scale invasion of Ukraine
items.summary: Russia’s Transport Ministry is proposing to extend, until the end of 2028, the special regime that allows Russian airlines to operate foreign aircraft and engines leased from foreign companies, Vedomosti reported, citing a draft government resolution it had reviewed.

ai.sum: Russia's Transport Ministry proposes extending until 2028 the regime letting airlines keep operating foreign-leased aircraft.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian ammunition depots in Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk regions
items.summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck two Russian ammunition depots in the Zaporizhzhia region on November 5 and overnight into November 6, as well as an enemy drone command post and a fuel and lubricant depot in the Donetsk region.

ai.sum: Ukrainian forces struck two Russian ammunition depots in Zaporizhzhia and a drone command post and fuel depot in Donetsk.

items.title: Mortar firing range instead of park: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence reveals how Russians are destroying Ukrainian nature reserves
items.summary: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine says Russian forces have set up a mortar range in Pryazovia National Nature Park and destroyed bird nesting sites in Meotyda park.

ai.sum: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence says Russian forces set up a mortar range in Pryazovia National Nature Park and destroyed bird nesting sites in Meotyda park.

items.title: Trump teases ‘beautiful’ deal covering ‘all of Europe’ after meeting Putin’s envoy
items.summary: An agreement is "going to involve more than Ukraine," the U.S. president said after a meeting with Kirill Dmitriev.

ai.sum: Trump says a deal covering all of Europe could follow his meeting with Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev, going beyond Ukraine.

items.title: Zelensky says Russian strikes have damaged every power plant in Ukraine
items.summary: Russian strikes have already damaged “every power plant” in Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelensky said November 5 in an address to participants of the 30th Ibero-American Summit.

ai.sum: Zelensky said Russian strikes have damaged every power plant in Ukraine, speaking at the 30th Ibero-American Summit.

items.title: NATO Seeks ‘Just’ End to Ukraine War as Trump Touts Deal Involving Europe

ai.sum: NATO seeks a 'just' end to the Ukraine war as Trump touts a deal that may involve Europe.

items.title: Kremlin views Russian delegation's meeting with US first lady positively
items.summary: Dmitry Peskov noted that the positive spirit and willingness to pursue humanitarian work remain

ai.sum: Kremlin spokesman Peskov welcomed a Russian delegation's meeting with the US first lady as positive for humanitarian work.

items.title: Press review: EU seeks peace talks role as Washington divisions deepen over Iran strategy
items.summary: Top stories from the Russian press on Friday, November 6th

ai.sum: Russian press review reports the EU seeks a role in peace talks as Washington divisions over Iran strategy deepen.

items.title: Political, humanitarian contacts with US complement each other perfectly, Kremlin says
items.summary: "It is a very good practice," Dmitry Peskov said

ai.sum: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov says political and humanitarian contacts with the US complement each other well.

items.title: Ukraine: Trump hails ‘big, beautiful agreement’ for ‘all of Europe’
items.summary: The US president has trumpeted a peace deal with Russia extending beyond Ukraine to cover the whole of Europe

ai.sum: Trump hailed a peace deal with Russia that he says extends to the whole of Europe, not only Ukraine.

items.title: Russian attack on Dnipropetrovsk region energy infrastructure leaves up to 50,000 subscribers without power
items.summary: Russian occupiers attacked the energy infrastructure of the Dnipropetrovsk region on Friday morning, November 6, Head of Dnipropetrovsk Regional Military Administration Oleksandr Hanzha reported.

ai.sum: Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region, leaving up to 50,000 subscribers without power.

items.title: Bodies of 53 people recovered from rubble of underground school in Komyshuvakha
items.summary: Search and rescue operations are continuing at the site of the November 2 airstrike in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. So far, rescuers have recovered the bodies of 53 people.

ai.sum: Rescuers have recovered 53 bodies from the rubble of an underground school in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia, after a November 2 airstrike.

items.title: Italy's Meloni Blasts Europe's 'Disarray' on Ukraine Talks

ai.sum: Italian PM Meloni criticized European disarray over Ukraine peace talks.

items.title: HACC to consider preventive measure for ex-top SBU official Friday at 1300
items.summary: The High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) will consider a petition on selecting a preventive measure for former First Deputy Head of the Department for Protection of National Statehood of the SBU Serhiy Duka, who is a suspect in Carthage case, on Friday at 13:00.

ai.sum: Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court will consider a preventive measure for former SBU official Serhiy Duka, a suspect in the Carthage case.

items.title: Power situation toughest in Kyiv, region - ministry, Ukrenergo
items.summary: The situation in the capital region remains the most difficult at present as a result of massive Russian shelling, the Energy Ministry said.

ai.sum: Ukraine's Energy Ministry says the power situation in Kyiv and its region is the most difficult after massive Russian shelling.

items.title: Finland defense minister calls for burden sharing on defense and Ukraine, for the sake of European unity
items.summary: Finland's Defense Minister Antti Hakkanen said European countries should commit at least 0.25% of GDP in support of Ukraine, which Kyiv has identified as the right percentage to keep it financially afloat.

ai.sum: Finnish Defence Minister Hakkanen urged European states to give at least 0.25% of GDP to support Ukraine.

items.title: ‘Everyone is just going to be thrilled’: Trump promises ‘big, beautiful agreement’ to end war in Ukraine
items.summary: President Donald Trump announced a “big beautiful agreement” on Ukraine that “might involve all of Europe.”

ai.sum: Trump announced a 'big beautiful agreement' to end the Ukraine war that may involve all of Europe.

items.title: Ukraine attacks Afipsky oil refinery in southern Russia
items.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked Krasnodar Krai, sparking a fire at an enterprise in the village of Afipsky after “debris falling”, the regional operational headquarters reported.

ai.sum: Ukrainian drones attacked Krasnodar Krai, sparking a fire at the Afipsky oil refinery area.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facilities in Kirovohrad region
items.summary: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in the Kirovohrad region overnight and early on November 6.

ai.sum: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in Ukraine's Kirovohrad region overnight into November 6.

items.title: Ayvazovska calls Zelenskyy’s e-voting statement dissonant amid rising cyberattacks
items.summary: Board Chair of the Civil Network OPORA and member of the working group on preparing legislation for conducting elections during wartime Olha Ayvazovska expressed skepticism regarding President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's statements concerning electronic voting in elections.

ai.sum: Olha Ayvazovska questions Zelensky's statements on electronic voting amid rising cyberattacks.

items.title: They got laboratories running again after liberation: Russian strike kills five disease control centre staff in Izium
items.summary: Five women who worked at a branch of the Kharkiv Oblast Centre for Disease Control and Prevention were killed in a Russian guided aerial bomb attack on the city of Izium on 29 October. They had been among the first to return to work after the city was liberated from Russian occupation.

ai.sum: A Russian guided aerial bomb killed five women working at a disease control centre branch in Izium on 29 October.

items.title: Reps of USA, Ukraine, EU, and European nations meet at NATO residence - spokesperson Hart
items.summary: Representatives from NATO, the United States, Ukraine, several European countries, and the EU met at the alliance’s residence ahead of planned trilateral talks between the USA, Ukraine, and Russia in Abu Dhabi.

ai.sum: Representatives of NATO, the US, Ukraine, European countries and the EU met at NATO's residence ahead of planned US-Ukraine-Russia trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Российским авиакомпаниям могут разрешить еще два года пользоваться иностранными самолетами, которые не вернули после начала войны
items.summary: Минтранс подготовил проект постановления о продлении до конца 2028 года особых правил эксплуатации зарубежных самолетов и двигателей, пишут «Ведомости». Причины. В Минтрансе объяснили необходимость продления режима защитой российских компаний от действий «недружественных стран». При этом иностранные владельцы считают договоры аренды расторгнутыми. Российские авиакомпании продолжают перечислять платежи на специальные счета, однако зарубежные компании не могут получить эти…

ai.sum: Russia's transport ministry drafted a decree extending until end-2028 special rules allowing Russian airlines to keep using foreign-owned aircraft.

items.title: Death toll from Nov 2 strike on Komyshuvakha rises to 53 – official
items.summary: The death toll as a result of a Russian airstrike on the village of Komyshuvakha (Zaporizhia region) on November 2 has risen to 53 people, Head of the Regional Military Administration Mykhailo Semikin reported.

ai.sum: The death toll from a November 2 Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha in Zaporizhia region has risen to 53.

items.title: Strike on Derhachi in Kharkiv region injures 2 police officers

ai.sum: A jet UAV strike in Derhachi, Kharkiv region, injured two police officers on duty.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit two Russian ammunition storage points in occupied parts of Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.summary: Ukrainian units have struck two Russian ammunition storage points in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, as well as a UAV ground control station and a fuel depot in Donetsk Oblast.
